ecosystem_figures.$note: Public THIRD-PARTY figures. Not Emerge Digital results, not Vela results. Twin of emerge-future's `ecosystem_figures` block — SYNCED IN MEANING, deliberately not in shape: that repo builds HTML routes so its entries carry `published_on` (routes), while Vela ships .jsx straight to the browser, so entries here carry `published_in` (repo-relative files). scripts/claims-lint.mjs enforces both directions.
ecosystem_figures.$history: Supersedes the `fpt_parent` block removed by vela-os-roai #54 / emerge-future #43 (2026-08-02). Same figures, different frame — 'parent' implied Emerge is an FPT subsidiary, the killed claim from the 2026-07-27 position. FPT's own published figures under explicit attribution were never the problem. NEVER reintroduce the `fpt_parent` key name.
ecosystem_figures.$attribution: Display ONLY under explicit attribution naming the source organisation. In this app that is the overview.jsx footnote ('Bench and credentials shown are FPT Corporation's …'), which is what makes the figures publishable at all.
ecosystem_figures.$as_of_means: `as_of` is when the figure entered or was last confirmed in THIS record — NOT when the source organisation published it. That is `source_period`, and every row below is needs_verification:true.
ecosystem_figures.$provenance_warning: Traced 2026-08-28 and it is CIRCULAR. DECISION-5.md sources these to issue #5; issue #5 sources them to the `future` site; `future` carried them in raw HTML with no citation. DECISION-5 asserts the ARR figure is 'real but Salesforce-wide' — that assertion has no external source behind it anywhere in the chain. Nothing here has been checked against a primary source.

figures.label: global Agentforce ARR YoY growth
figures.verification_note: Withheld on BOTH surfaces — emerge-future #56 removed it from the homepage band, and it left this repo with the agentforceArrNote deletion. NOTE FOR REVIEW: DECISION-5.md (signed off 2026-06-16) decided 'Include, relabeled as Salesforce global'. Withholding it therefore DEVIATES from a signed decision and is Rami's to ratify or reverse. The case for withholding: a growth multiplier is the highest-risk shape of unsourced figure (cf. the +54%/+41% pair hub PR #95 retracted as invented) and the provenance chain is circular. To restore: cite a Salesforce release in source_url, flip published, and add it back to both surfaces together.
